params.caption: 🏆 Overwatch brings back 6v6 role queue Blizzard is returning 6v6 role queue to Overwatch after player feedback, and says it is committing to 6v6 alongside the current 5v5 format. It is a major win for players who have asked for the classic team size since the switch to 5v5. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 21:39 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC #Overwatch #Blizzard #GamingNews
